interpretation.stableWeekDefinition: challenger gated margin MAE <= incumbent gated margin MAE + 0.10
interpretation.concentrationRule: gated margin MAE must improve by at least 0.10 while non-gated projections remain exactly equal to incumbent
interpretation.probabilityRule: gated Brier and log loss must be non-inferior
interpretation.seasonRule: at least two prospective seasons must contain graded gate-fired games
interpretation.totalsRule: challenger total must equal incumbent total for every frozen row
interpretation.temporalRule: no state or market evidence timestamp may be later than the freeze timestamp

finalDecision: Passing this research gate never promotes automatically. Explicit operator approval is still required.
